title: Morning pour
brief: A short film about the ten seconds that make a morning worth getting up for: the pour. Not the gear. Just the sound and the steam.

assets.name: Punchy reference
assets.description: Fast creator reference. Hard cuts, warm grade, bold captions, hook in the first second.

assets.name: Window
assets.description: Wide, slow. Blue morning light on an empty oak table. Almost still. Quiet on purpose.

assets.name: Grind
assets.description: Close, rhythmic. The grinder chatters. Hands are a little clumsy. Texture, not the hero.

assets.name: Pour
assets.description: The hero. Coffee leaves the kettle in a ribbon. Steam. The best frame is the middle of the pour.

assets.name: Sip
assets.description: Payoff. The cup comes up, a pause, a small exhale. End on the cup lowering.

assets.name: Counter
assets.description: Accidental recording. The phone sat on the counter. Mostly nothing. One cupboard around eight seconds.
